reason: My current dispatch package does the job well enough and holds years of our bookings and customer history. Even if they do the move for free, I'm the one who has to learn it and retrain the drivers in the middle of school excursion season, and I don't have time for that.
objection: It's a brand new company with no other operators on it. If it falls over, or they shut down in two years, I've moved my whole business onto it and have to move it all again. An Excel export doesn't run my dispatch.
would_change_my_mind: Hearing from two or three operators my size at the bus association meeting who've been running it for six months, and who say the migration and the drivers' phone app actually worked.
